I can't give you an amount for fish oil, and joints are a medical question, so that one belongs with a doctor or a registered dietitian. They can tell you whether it makes sense for you and what's right given your health and any medications.

In general terms, fish oil is one of the most common supplements people ask about, but I can't say what it would do for you. I can help with the training side, like how your lifts are loading your joints or how to structure your sessions. Want to look at that?
